title: adjoint functor
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch7 §3 的左/右 Beck–Chevalley 条件与对应范畴万有性质：沿 horiz 的态射取右伴随、沿 vert 的态射取左伴随
definition_zh: 伴随函子是一对函子 $F:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ 与 $G:\mathcal{D}\to\mathcal{C}$，连同单位自然变换 $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal{C}}\to G\circ F$ 与余单位 $F\circ G\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal{D}}$，并满足三角恒等式；等价地，存在自然同构 $\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{D}}(F(c),d)\simeq\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathcal{C}}(c,G(d))$。在 $(\infty,1)$-语境中，同构被换成空间的同伦等价，伴随亦可由单位/余单位数据或可表性刻画。DAG 第 7 章用「每条 horiz 态射的像有右伴随」「每条 vert 态射的像有左伴随」表述 Beck–Chevalley 条件，并用伴随的单位与余单位把对应范畴的 2-态射编码为方块之间的同构。
key_points: 左伴随 $F\dashv G$ 唯一到典范同构；在 $\infty$-范畴中，伴随可由单位/余单位、也可由 Hom 空间的自然等价刻画
DAG §3.1 定义 3.1.2：对每条 $\alpha\in\mathit{horiz}$，$\Phi(\alpha)$ 有右伴随，记作 $\Phi^{!}(\alpha)$；定义 3.1.5：对每条 $\beta\in\mathit{vert}$，$\Phi^{!}(\beta)$ 有左伴随，记作 $\Phi(\beta)$
Beck–Chevalley 条件要求这些逐点的伴随与方块的基变换相容，即 (3.3) 的 2-态射 $\Phi(\beta_1)\circ\Phi^{!}(\alpha_0)\to\Phi^{!}(\alpha_1)\circ\Phi(\beta_0)$ 是同构
定理 3.2.2 的万有性质把「满足左/右 BC 的函子」与「从对应范畴 $\mathrm{Corr}(\mathcal{C})$ 出发的函子」等同；(3.4)/(3.5) 的左伴随与单位/余单位图是该构造的核心
idea_original: The concept of adjoint functors [Kan (1958)] is a key concept in category theory — if not the key concept — and it is in large part through the manifold identification of examples of adjoint functors appearing ubiquitously in the practice of mathematics that category theoretic tools are brought to use in general mathematics. Abstractly, the notion of adjoint functors embodies the concept of representable functors and has as special cases the fundamental universal constructions of category theory such as notably Kan extensions and hence (co-)limits and (co-)ends, while being itself the archetypical special case of a natural notion of adjunction which in 2-category theory embodies a general principle of duality. Concretely, the concept of adjoint functors L⊣R:𝒟⇆𝒞L \dashv R \,\colon\, \mathcal{D} \leftrightarrows \mathcal{C} is immediately transparent and compelling in its incarnation as a natural isomorphism on hom-sets (see below) and more generally on hom-objects (see at enriched adjoint functor), where it just says that adjoint functors are those that may coherently be switched left↔\leftrightarrowright in a hom-set L⊣R:𝒟⇆RL𝒞 means 𝒟(L(−),−)≃𝒞(−,R(−)).
